title: Rebuilding a payments platform for scale
excerpt: A managed team for a fintech moving from a monolith to services.

meta.headline: A **managed team** that took a fintech **from monolith to services**.
meta.summary: A tech lead, four backend engineers and a Salesforce developer moved Lumen Pay's payment flows to services and connected them to the sales team's CRM.

blocks.title: Challenge
blocks.body: Lumen Pay's monolith could not keep up with transaction growth, and every release risked downtime. Sales had no view of customer payment health.

blocks.title: Solution
blocks.body: A managed team led by our tech lead split the payment flows into services behind a gateway, added observability, and synced payment health into Salesforce so account managers could act before customers churned.
